description: Rainfall intelligence system, helping farmers on analysing rainfall reliability
summary:
AgriTelligence is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform developed to help farmers make better-informed farming decisions using NASA Earth observation data.

The platform integrates NASA POWER environmental data, including rainfall, air temperature and root-zone soil wetness where available, to provide location-specific agricultural insights. Through interactive visualizations, farmers can examine recent environmental conditions, compare observations and explore information relevant to crops such as maize, cassava, beans and sorghum.

AgriTelligence also features an AI farming assistant designed to interpret available environmental observations and explain their implications in simple, practical language.

The project addresses the difficulty many smallholder farmers face in accessing and understanding scientific environmental information. By combining NASA data, artificial intelligence and an accessible digital interface, AgriTelligence aims to bridge the gap between Earth observation science and everyday agricultural decision-making, supporting more informed farming practices and climate resilience.
details:
The Problem

Smallholder farmers often make agricultural decisions with limited access to reliable environmental information. Rainfall variability, temperature changes and soil conditions can affect agricultural planning, yet satellite-derived information is frequently presented in scientific formats that are difficult for non-specialists to interpret.

AgriTelligence was developed to help address this information gap.

Our Solution

AgriTelligence is an interactive agricultural intelligence application that combines NASA environmental observations with accessible visualizations and an AI-powered farming assistant.

The application allows users to select a location in Uganda or enter geographic coordinates to explore available environmental data relevant to their farming activities.

How It Works

1. Location Selection

Users select a Ugandan location, enter their own coordinates or use browser-supported location access.

2. NASA Earth Data

The application requests daily observations from NASA's Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) service.

The main variables are:

  • T2M: Daily mean air temperature.
  • PRECTOTCORR: Daily precipitation.
  • GWETROOT: Modeled root-zone soil wetness, when available.

3. Interactive Data Analysis

The retrieved observations are processed and presented through interactive charts, dated records and environmental summaries. Users can investigate recent available observations and download climate data in CSV format.

4. Crop-Based Exploration

Users can explore information relevant to maize, cassava, beans and sorghum. The application helps connect environmental conditions with agricultural questions.

5. AI Farming Assistant

The AI assistant is designed to receive a farmer's question alongside the selected crop and available NASA observations. It then generates an explanation tailored to the supplied environmental information.

AI requests are handled through server-side integrations that support OpenAI or Anthropic services when configured.

6. Field Notes

Users can record and save agricultural observations within their browsers for later reference.

Technologies Used

AgriTelligence was developed using:

  • Next.js and React for the web application.
  • TypeScript for application logic.
  • Tailwind CSS for responsive design.
  • Recharts for environmental data visualization.
  • NASA POWER API for environmental observations.
  • Server-side API routes for data retrieval and AI integration.
  • Browser storage for field notes.
  • GitHub and Vercel as the intended source-hosting and deployment platforms.

What Makes AgriTelligence Different?

AgriTelligence focuses on making NASA environmental information understandable and useful to farmers.

Instead of presenting scientific observations without explanation, the platform combines location-based climate records, crop selection, interactive analysis and an AI assistant within one interface.

The application also distinguishes historical observations from forecasts, identifies unavailable measurements and avoids guaranteeing planting success based on limited environmental information.

Intended Impact

The initial focus is Uganda, particularly smallholder farmers, agricultural students and extension workers.

AgriTelligence aims to improve access to environmental information, strengthen climate awareness and support better-informed agricultural planning.

The platform is designed with the potential to expand to additional crops, locations, languages and agricultural data sources.

Development and Limitations

The project includes the application interface, NASA POWER integration code, environmental data-processing tools and server-side AI integration.

The current build has passed syntax and NASA-format data-parsing checks. Live NASA responses, AI service responses and the public production deployment require final verification.

NASA POWER observations do not replace field measurements, local agricultural expertise or seasonal forecasts. AgriTelligence is intended to support informed decisions rather than guarantee agricultural outcomes.
